title: tac.missiles
description: Missiles in flight in a side's picture, most threatening first: track, team or IFF, position and velocity, weapon, launcher, target, state, fired time, cost in KSP funds and time to closest approach. Needs the BDArmory binding in a flight scene (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE tactical_not_attached without it).

view.description: Picture to read: a team name (your own side unless you are a human, referee or director), or "god" for the truth (needs privilege or fog off). Defaults to the session's side.
